A full complement of airbags, including front side-impact and overhead airbags, surrounds occupants with protection.

The X-Line EX trim emphasizes capability with its distinctive 21-inch alloy wheels and practical features like the power liftgate that opens with the push of a button. A rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers ensure clear visibility in all weather. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seating provide flexibility for passengers and cargo configurations.

Advanced technology complements the driving experience through SiriusXM satellite radio, an emergency communication system, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare while driving in varied light conditions, while delay-off headlights and fully automatic headlights enhance visibility and convenience.

Visit our showroom to experience the 2027 Telluride X-Line EX firsthand and discover how its three-row seating, powerful turbocharged engine, and comprehensive feature set can meet your family's transportation needs. Price includes $699 of dealer added accessories.

description:
Introducing the 2026 Buick Enclave Sport Touring a three-row midsize SUV designed for families and drivers who prioritize comfort, capability, and refined styling.

- Front Passenger 6-Way Power Seat Adjuster
- Power driver seat with 8-Way adjustment and 4-Way Power Lumbar
- Power Liftgate for convenient loading and unloading
- Auto High-beam Headlights for enhanced visibility
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto with wireless connectivity
- Auto-dimming Rear-View mirror and auto-dimming door mirrors
- Navigation System integrated into the Infotainment Center
- Bose Premium 12-Speaker Audio System with Subwoofer
- SiriusXM with 360L Trial Subscription
- Heated steering wheel and heated front seats
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- Perforated leatherette seat trim with front bucket seats
- 20 alloy wheels with high gloss black and machine finish
- Three-row seating with split-bench third row
- OnStar and Buick connected services capability

The Sport Touring trim delivers commanding presence with its white exterior and aggressive styling cues. The Enclave seats up to seven passengers across three rows, making it an excellent choice for larger families or those who frequently transport groups. The third-row split-bench configuration provides flexibility for passengers and cargo, while the power liftgate simplifies access to the cargo area.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes driver and passenger comfort with heated front seats and an eight-way power driver seat featuring lumbar adjustment. The front passenger seat offers six-way power adjustment with four-way lumbar support. The steering wheel is heated and wrapped in leather, and the telescoping, tilt design allows personalized positioning. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps front occupants comfortable, while rear air conditioning ensures passengers throughout the vehicle remain satisfied.

Technology integration centers on the Buick Infotainment System with navigation and a 12-speaker Bose audio setup that includes a subwoofer, delivering quality sound for your favorite music, podcasts, and SiriusXM content. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow seamless smartphone integration, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror and auto-dimming door mirrors enhance visibility and reduce glare during day or night driving. The heated steering wheel adds welcome comfort during colder months.

Safety features include four-wheel independent suspension, electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive airbag system across the front and sides. The Enclave is equipped with OnStar and Buick connected services, providing emergency communication and roadside support. Low tire pressure monitoring and brake assist round out the protective systems.

The 2.5L DOHC engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive delivers balanced performance and efficiency. Combined fuel economy reaches 22 MPG city and 25 MPG highway, making this SUV practical for both daily commutes and longer journeys.

With 22,446 miles on the odometer, this 2026 Buick Enclave Sport Touring remains in excellent condition and ready for years of dependable service. Contact our dealership today to schedule a test drive and experience the spacious comfort and refined driving dynamics this three-row SUV has to offer.

- DROP-IN BED LINER & BUMPER STEP
- TOW PACKAGE with tow hitch and tow harness
- MUD FLAPS

Power windows, power door mirrors, and remote keyless entry add daily convenience.

The 17-inch painted alloy wheels complement the gray exterior while the rear step bumper and body-color bumpers maintain the truck's professional appearance. With a focus on capability combined with modern amenities, the 2026 Nissan Frontier PRO-4X is ready to handle whatever you need.

This 2024 Hyundai Palisade Calligraphy represents a sophisticated choice for those seeking a well-equipped three-row SUV that combines refined styling with practical functionality for the modern family.

- 12-speaker Harman/Kardon premium audio system
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power moonroof with auto-open and close

- Heated rear seats for added comfort
- Premium Nappa leather seat trim
- Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone and rear air conditioning
- Heads-up display projecting key driving information
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and heated door mirrors
- 20-inch Calligraphy exclusive alloy wheels
- Electronic stability control with traction control

- Rear exterior parking camera
- Rear window defroster and rain-sensing wipers
- HomeLink garage door transmitter integration

The Calligraphy trim stands out with its attention to comfort and convenience. The Hyper White exterior finish presents a clean, modern appearance that complements the vehicle's sophisticated design. Inside, the premium Nappa leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, and available rear heating create an inviting environment for all passengers. The power moonroof adds an open-air feeling when desired, while the heads-up display keeps important information within your line of sight.

Passengers in all three rows benefit from thoughtful climate control, with individual front dual-zone air conditioning and dedicated rear air conditioning for those seated behind. The Harman/Kardon audio system delivers quality sound whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio or streaming through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The navigation system ensures you arrive confidently at your destination.

Safety and handling are prioritized throughout this SUV. The four-wheel independent suspension with auto-leveling technology provides a composed ride, while the electronic stability control and traction control systems work to maintain grip in varying conditions. Speed-sensing steering adjusts responsiveness based on vehicle speed, and comprehensive airbag coverage protects occupants throughout the cabin.

The V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission delivers adequate performance for highway cruising and daily driving, achieving 19 mpg in the city and 24 mpg on the highway. The all-wheel-drive system provides capability across different road conditions, while the 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS ensure confident stopping power.

This Palisade Calligraphy offers the space, refinement, and features expected from a premium family SUV. We invite you to schedule a test drive to experience how this vehicle can serve your family's transportation needs.

description: Some cars earn their reputation through advertising. Others earn it by spending decades proving themselves on the road. This 2006 Honda Civic LX falls firmly into the second category. With 178,299 miles, this Civic isn't pretending to be a low-mileage time capsule. What makes it compelling is the story behind those miles: one owner, an accident-free vehicle history, and local trade ownership. On an 18-year-old vehicle, that's exactly the kind of history worth paying attention to. Finished in beautiful Atomic Blue Metallic over a Gray cloth interior, this Civic still has the clean, distinctive styling that helped completely redefine the compact-car segment when this generation debuted. Even today, its low-profile windshield, simple proportions, and driver-focused cabin give it a personality that stands apart from the typical inexpensive commuter car. Under the hood is Honda's proven naturally aspirated 1.8-liter four-cylinder VTEC engine paired with a traditional 5-speed automatic transmission. It's straightforward Honda engineering from an era before small turbocharged engines and increasingly complicated drivetrains became commonplace. And efficiency remains impressive even by modern standards. With an EPA-estimated 30 MPG city and 40 MPG highway, this Civic can make an excellent commuter, first car, student vehicle, or inexpensive everyday runabout for someone who simply wants to keep fuel and ownership costs under control. Inside, the LX keeps things refreshingly simple. Air conditioning, power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, cruise control, a telescoping steering wheel, and AM/FM/CD audio provide the essentials without layers of unnecessary technology. But the strongest argument for this particular Civic isn't the equipment list. It's the ownership history. Finding a 2006 vehicle with one-owner history is becoming increasingly uncommon. Finding one that's also accident-free and a local trade is harder still. At this age and mileage, how a vehicle arrived at your dealership can matter every bit as much as the number showing on the odometer. There's also some history attached to this generation. The redesigned 2006 Honda Civic was named the North American Car of the Year, helping establish this eighth-generation Civic as one of the defining compact cars of its era. That reputation is part of why you still see so many of them on the road today. Offered by Honda of Kirkland, there's something fitting about a one-owner Civic like this returning to a Honda dealership nearly two decades into its life. - Power running boards and power bed step
- Spray-on bed liner
- 3.4L V6 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD capability

The exterior presents itself in off-white with purposeful styling. The 20-inch dark painted alloy wheels complement the truck's stance, while the spray-on bed liner provides practical protection for hauling and storage. Power running boards make entry and exit effortless, and the power bed step ensures convenient access to the cargo area without unnecessary strain.

Heated and ventilated front seats dressed in leather keep you comfortable across seasons, while the heated steering wheel adds warmth during cold weather drives. Dual-zone automatic climate control allows driver and passenger to set individual temperature preferences. The power moonroof opens overhead space and natural light, enhancing the cabin atmosphere.

description:
This 2020 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali delivers the capability and refinement you expect from a premium truck built to handle both work and the open road.

- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with Dynamic Fuel Management operating in up to 17 different patterns for optimized power and efficiency
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Denali Ultimate Package including Technology Package, Driver Alert Package II, and power sunroof
- 22-inch multi-dimensional polished aluminum wheels with 6-spoke design
- GMC MultiPro Power Steps for convenient entry and exit
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM 360L and HD Radio
- Navigation system with GMC Infotainment
- Adaptive Cruise Control with forward collision alert and pedestrian braking
- HD Surround Vision with rear camera mirror and trailer view capabilities
- Heated and ventilated front seats with 10-way power adjustment and lumbar support
- Heated rear seats and heated steering wheel
- Spray-on pickup bed liner with Denali logo
- ProGrade Trailering System with integrated trailer brake controller and tire pressure monitor
- Onyx Black exterior with signature Denali grille and body-color bumpers
- All-weather floor liners and front and rear molded splash guards

The 6.2L V8 produces 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque, delivering the performance you need when it matters. The Dynamic Fuel Management system adjusts between 2 and 8 cylinders depending on demand, balancing power with efficiency. Paired with the smooth 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD capability, this truck is engineered for both highway confidence and challenging terrain.

Inside, the Denali Ultimate Package creates a premium environment with its Technology Package integration and comprehensive driver assistance features. The GMC Infotainment system with navigation works seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected throughout your drive. Adaptive Cruise Control, lane keep assist, and lane change alert with side blind zone detection add layers of driving confidence. The multicolor 15-inch head-up display keeps critical information at your line of sight.

Comfort extends throughout the cabin with heated and ventilated front seats featuring 10-way power adjustment and lumbar support. Heated rear seats and a heated steering wheel make cold morning commutes more pleasant. The power sunroof opens your view to the sky, while genuine wood trim accents add an upscale feel to the interior.

For those who tow, the ProGrade Trailering System is built with integrated trailer brake control, hitch guidance with hitch view, and a trailer tire pressure monitor system. The HD Surround Vision with trailer view camera provisions gives you complete visibility when hitching or maneuvering. The heavy-duty rear locking differential and auxiliary transmission oil cooler support demanding towing applications.

The black exterior paired with 22-inch polished aluminum wheels and the signature Denali grille creates a commanding presence on any road. The spray-on bed liner protects against wear, while GMC MultiPro Power Steps make accessing the bed easy and safe.

Contact us to schedule a test drive and experience how this Sierra 1500 Denali combines capability with the refinement of a premium truck.

Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road, while the trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.

This Civic Sport represents a smart choice for buyers who appreciate Honda's track record of durability and value, delivering a dependable vehicle that meets your daily needs without compromise.

Meet the 2025 Ford F-150 XLT, a truck engineered to handle demanding work and deliver commanding presence on any road. - Black Widow custom appearance package

- Power-sliding rear window with remote operation
- Bed Utility Package including LED box lighting and tie-down plates

The exterior showcases the aggressive XLT Black Appearance Package Plus, featuring a black grille with chrome center bar, black exterior badging, and striking 20-inch gloss black wheels. Complementing this bold stance are 6-inch black running boards, body-color front and rear bumpers, and dual exhaust with black tips. The blue metallic paint adds depth and sophistication to the muscular truck profile.

Inside, the cabin reflects both capability and comfort. The B&O Sound System elevates your daily drive with premium audio quality, while dual-zone electronic climate control ensures everyone rides in comfort. The wrapped steering wheel, power-adjustable pedals, and heated front seats demonstrate attention to driver experience. The mobile office setup with console worksurface and partitioned lockable storage transforms the cab into a practical workspace.

Safety and technology integrate seamlessly throughout this truck. Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 provides comprehensive driver support with features like evasive steering assist, forward collision warning, and lane centering. The 360-degree camera system offers complete visibility when maneuvering, while front and rear parking sensors help you navigate tight spaces with confidence. Connected Navigation services come with a complimentary 1-year trial, keeping you informed and on course.

The bed work area reflects practical design with LED lighting for nighttime visibility and four pickup box tie-down plates for securing cargo. The tailgate work surface and step make loading and unloading simpler. Power-sliding rear window functionality adds convenience for longer loads or equipment access.

This 2025 Ford F-150 XLT represents a serious investment in capability, technology, and performance. With 692 miles on the odometer, it stands ready to transition from showroom to your ownership. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discover how its combination of raw power, intelligent features, and refined interior can serve your needs.

The GLS 580 4MATIC® features a 4.0L V8 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive technology, delivering responsive performance for both highway driving and daily commutes. The exterior Blue finish presents a striking appearance, while the interior offers leather upholstery throughout the seven-seat configuration, ensuring comfort for all passengers across multiple rows.

Climate control technology includes front and rear dual-zone automatic temperature control, heated and ventilated front seats, and rear air conditioning with independent controls. The heated steering wheel and heated front armrest provide additional comfort during cooler months. The panoramic moonroof with infrared-reflecting glass allows natural light while maintaining cabin temperature comfort.

Advanced driving features enhance both safety and convenience. The adaptive suspension with auto-leveling capability adjusts to road conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension ensures a refined ride. Safety systems include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, and the eCall emergency communication system. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to maintain vehicle control in challenging conditions.

Interior appointments reflect Mercedes-Benz quality standards. The MBUX multimedia system with Burmester® surround sound delivers premium audio through 13 speakers, while SiriusXM and weather band radio keep you connected. The wood and leather multifunction steering wheel, heated and power-adjustable front seats with memory settings, and heated rear armrests contribute to the overall luxury experience. Under the hood sits Volkswagen's proven 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission with Tiptronic manual-shift capability. The R-Line designation adds a sporty aesthetic layer on top of the SEL's luxury touches. It's the visual upgrade that helps this crossover stand out from more conservative options in the segment.

===== Volkswagen Atlas Cross Sport Reliability and Ownership =====

Volkswagen significantly improved the Atlas platform's reliability reputation in recent model years, and the 2024 iteration reflects that maturity. Owner feedback consistently praises the Atlas Cross Sport for its composed highway ride, intuitive infotainment system, and the quality feel of interior materials especially at the SEL level. The 2.0T engine is a well-established powerplant used across multiple VW and Audi vehicles, with a strong track record for durability when maintained properly. Forward-thinking features like Honda's emergency communication system through HondaLink keep you connected should you need assistance.

Beyond the specifications, this 2024 Civic Touring is built for drivers who value substance over trend. Every control is logically placed, every surface is quality material, and every system is designed to work intuitively. Whether you're navigating city streets or cruising highways, this sedan responds to your needs with understated confidence and genuine capability.

- Dual panel glass sunroof with power tilt and sliding functionality
- 20-inch dynamic 9-spoke alloy wheels with all-season tires
- Cadillac User Experience with embedded navigation and real-time traffic

- Heated driver and front passenger seats
- Heated automatic steering wheel

- Following Distance Indicator
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- IntelliBeam automatic high beam control

- Automatic emergency braking
- Bose Centerpoint Surround Sound 13-speaker system
- Wireless charging

The exterior presents a striking Red Horizon Tintcoat finish that commands attention on the road. The XT4 Premium Luxury combines compact SUV proportions with a premium interior that prioritizes comfort and convenience for both driver and passengers.

Under the hood, a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine delivers responsive performance paired with a nine-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. City driving yields approximately 24 miles per gallon, while highway stretches provide around 30 miles per gallon, balancing efficiency with capability.

The cabin reflects Cadillac's commitment to a premium environment. Leather seating surfaces and ventilated front seats create an inviting atmosphere, while the eight-way power driver seat and six-way power passenger seat with lumbar controls accommodate various body types and preferences. The heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, and rear window defroster ensure comfort across seasons.

Driver assistance technology enhances confidence on every journey. The reconfigurable full-color head-up display keeps critical information within your line of sight, while the HD rear vision camera and park assist systems simplify maneuvering in tight spaces. Following Distance Indicator, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, and IntelliBeam technology work together to support safer driving.

This XT4 Premium Luxury arrives with all-weather floor liners and a cargo liner, protecting your investment from the elements. The OnStar emergency communication system and Cadillac connected services provide an additional layer of security and convenience.

BRAND-NEW TURBOCHARGERS

Recently fitted with new turbochargers. This is the most expensive wear item on a 991.2, and the next owner gets it fresh no deferred maintenance, no looming repair bill. Invoice and documentation upon request.

PERFORMANCE

Twin-turbocharged 3.0L flat-six with 7-speed PDK. From the factory this car made 370 hp and 331 lb-ft. APR's Stage 1 ECU upgrade for the 991.2 3.0T is rated at 454501 hp and 439523 lb-ft depending on fuel grade Carrera S/GTS territory from a car that still idles, drives, and behaves exactly like a stock 911. Stage 1 requires no engine hardware modifications.

WHY THE TCU & ECU TUNE MATTERS

This is the part most tuned PDK cars are missing. The factory PDK limits torque to protect its clutches, so an ECU tune alone gets held back by the transmission's own safety intervention. APR's TCU calibration raises the transmission's torque capacity and increases clutch clamping pressure to prevent slip under the added torque protecting the clutches rather than wearing them out. APR specifically states the ECU and TCU must run together, since the two share data to time each shift correctly. The result is quicker shifts, optimized wide-open-throttle shift points, and full power delivery without the car pulling torque mid-gear.

Both tunes are software-only on the factory controllers. The ECU flashes through the OBD-II port with no physical modification, and the car can be returned to stock if a future owner prefers.

FACTORY OPTIONS (per original window sticker, included)

7-Speed PDK
Premium Package Plus with 14-Way Power Sport Seats
Bose Surround Sound System
20 911 Turbo Wheels
Agate Grey Metallic paint
Power Folding Exterior Mirrors
Lane Change Assist
ParkAssist front and rear with back-up camera
PASM adaptive suspension

Agate Grey over Black is restrained and timeless. The power soft top drops in about 13 seconds at speeds up to 30 mph a genuine everyday convertible, not a weekend-only car.

CONDITION

Excellent.
